items.source: Creates ParentKeys with backreference for the given path and value of the parents id.
items.translation: 为给定路径和父级 ID 值创建带有回引用的 ParentKeys。

items.source: Builder for Identifier. Mainly for internal use within the framework
items.translation: Identifier 的构建器。主要用于框架内部。

items.source: Adds a qualifier to the identifier to build.
items.translation: 向构建标识符添加限定符。

items.source: Adds a qualifier to the identifier to build. A qualifier is a map key or a list index.
items.translation: 向构建标识符添加限定符。限定符是映射键或列表索引。

items.source: valueProvider - provides values for the Identifier based on an AggregatePath. Must not be null.
items.translation: valueProvider - 基于 AggregatePath 为 Identifier 提供值。不得为 null。

items.source: path - path to the map that gets qualified by value. Must not be null.
items.translation: path - 由 value 限定范围的地图路径。不能为 null。

items.source: value - map key or list index qualifying the map identified by path. Must not be null.
items.translation: value - 用于标识由 path 指定的 Map 的 Map 键或列表索引。不能为 null。

items.source: converter - used for determining the column types to be used for different properties. Must not be null.
items.translation: converter - 用于确定不同属性应使用的列类型。不得为 null。

items.source: path - the path for which needs to back reference an id. Must not be null.
items.translation: path - 需要回引用 ID 的路径。不能为 null。

items.source: defaultIdentifier - Identifier to be used as a default when no backreference can be constructed. Must not be null.
items.translation: defaultIdentifier - 当无法构建回引用时，将用作默认标识符。不得为 null。

items.source: this builder. Guaranteed to be not null.
items.translation: 该构建器。保证不为 null。
